goal: Prospective paper-held-out validation of specified-cycle capacitance retention

subgroup.denominator: all eligible primary-scope records; report BET unavailable count

baseline: P64 equal GPR/RF with fixed configuration and 23 archived development endpoints, when independent of all held papers
challenger: For target 10000 cycles only, fit P67 midpoint augmentation using the frozen 15 author-figure observations and original 23 endpoints; retain P64 estimator and weight settings. For other targets reuse the baseline.
training_sources: Check DOI, author/title and potential shared experimental lineage against frozen development sources. Reclassify pre-exposed or same-experiment sources as development.
before_unseal: Confirm provenance, actual test protocol, three time-bounded points on same curve, normalization, and early scope; verify prediction lock including each eligible record and baseline outputs before reading its endpoint.
generalization: At least10 development source families and genuinely new untouched external-source validation; reuse of these development sources alone never achieves reliable-model acceptance.
queries: TITLE_ABS:supercapacitor* AND (TITLE_ABS:"biomass-derived" OR TITLE_ABS:"porous carbon") AND TITLE_ABS:KOH AND TITLE_ABS:"three-electrode" AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y
TITLE:supercapacitor* AND (TITLE:biomass OR TITLE:straw OR TITLE:peel OR TITLE:shell OR TITLE:seed) AND TITLE_ABS:KOH AND TITLE_ABS:cycling AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y
TITLE_ABS:supercapacitor* AND (TITLE:biochar OR TITLE:"activated carbon" OR TITLE:"biomass derived") AND (TITLE_ABS:"10000 cycles" OR TITLE_ABS:"10,000 cycles") AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y
